topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate pathogen recognition and receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how innate immune cells detect microbial products and cellular damage through pattern recognition receptors and downstream activation pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory response propagation and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the initial activation of tissue sentinel cells translates into cellular recruitment, tissue trafficking, and potential systemic pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, guide tissue repair, and maintain containment when tissue insults cannot be fully resolved.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on complement.
